transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 312 Great Glen Drive?
Yes, this is 312 Great Glen Drive. I’m alone and the water’s not in yet. I can help with a truck.
Thanks for confirming your address and offering the truck. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
One person is here. I can help with the truck.

Thank you for letting us know you can help with the truck. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
No one here can’t leave on their own. No wheelchair or oxygen needed.
Understood, no one here can’t leave on their own. Is there water inside the home right now?
No water inside. I can help—got a truck.
Thanks for your offer to help. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
I have a high-clearance truck. No free seats in a vehicle.
Thanks for sharing your truck info. Let me read that back: 1 people; no water inside yet; you can help with a truck. Is that right?
Yes. One person. No water inside. I can help with a truck.

Thanks for confirming and offering to help with a truck. I've recorded that you may be able to help neighbors. A dispatcher may contact you. Only go out if it's safe for you, and never drive into water you can't see the bottom of. Goodbye.
